items.title: Launch of a Cooperation Project for Women’s and Girls’ Leadership in Senegal
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 24 LUG - The Italian Ambassador to Senegal, Michele Tommasi, spoke at the first meeting of the National Steering Committee for the Parel/F project—an initiative funded by Italian Cooperation to strengthen the leadership and socioeconomic inclusion of women and girls in Senegal—to reaffirm Italy’s support for this initiative. The meeting was opened by the Chief of Staff of the Ministry of Family, Social Action, and Solidarity, Amadou Diaw, and by the Director of AICS Dakar, Giovanni Grandi, officially launching the project’s operational phase. items.titleIt: Launch of a Cooperation Project for Women’s and Girls’ Leadership in Senegal

items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.
items.titleIt: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.
items.titleIt: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran

items.title: The 2026 edition of Vinitaly.us was unveiled aboard the ship Vespucci in Québec City.
items.description: (ANSA) - ROMA, 27 LUG - The Italian Ambassador to Canada, Alessandro Cattaneo, presented the 2026 edition of “Vinitaly.us” aboard the Amerigo Vespucci, which made a stop in Québec City.
